hyperedges.label: Per-Host Skill Variants of One Pipeline

nodes.label: /graphify Pipeline (Claude Skill)
nodes.rationale: Turns any folder of files into a navigable knowledge graph with community detection and an honest audit trail, producing HTML, GraphRAG-ready JSON, and a plain-language report.

nodes.label: Step B2 - Dispatch Subagents (Claude)
nodes.rationale: Subagents must write to CHUNK_PATH on disk; the extraction spec is loaded only when a chunk holds a doc, paper, or image so a pure-code corpus never reads it.

nodes.label: Step B3 - Collect, Cache, and Merge
nodes.rationale: File-exists-on-disk is the success signal because a read-only (Explore) subagent silently produces nothing; missing chunks must be warned about rather than skipped, and a failure of more than half the chunks aborts the run.

nodes.label: Step B0 - Check Extraction Cache
nodes.rationale: Cache entries are stamped with SPEC_PATH (the prompt that produced them) so a graphify upgrade that changes the prompt re-extracts instead of replaying stale entries (#1939).

nodes.label: Part C - Merge AST + Semantic
nodes.rationale: AST nodes take precedence and semantic nodes are deduplicated by id, so deterministic structural extraction wins over LLM output on id collisions.

nodes.label: Step 4 - Build, Cluster, Analyze
nodes.rationale: Guards run before any write: an empty extraction must not clobber a good graph.json/report (#1392), and export happens first so the report and analysis sidecar never describe a graph that graph.json does not contain.

nodes.label: #479 Shrink Guard
nodes.rationale: to_json returns False and writes nothing when the new graph is smaller than the existing graph.json, so a partial extraction cannot silently destroy a larger prior graph; an intentional shrink requires a full rebuild with --force.

nodes.label: Step 4.5 - Graph Health Check
nodes.rationale: A read-only gate that never aborts, surfacing edge collapse, dangling/missing endpoints and self-loops — the silent-corruption modes of incremental updates and AST/LLM id mismatches.

nodes.label: Step 5 - Label Communities
nodes.rationale: Re-exports so graph.json nodes carry the curated community_name (#2490); questions are regenerated with real labels because labels affect question phrasing.

nodes.label: Step 6 - Obsidian + HTML Export
nodes.rationale: Obsidian is opt-in because it generates one file per node; HTML is the always-on default unless --no-viz.

nodes.label: Step 9 - Manifest, Cost, Cleanup
nodes.rationale: Only semantic files that actually produced output are stamped, so a failed chunk stays unstamped and is re-queued by the next --update rather than being marked done and lost forever (#2015); dispatched-but-unstamped files have their stale semantic_hash cleared (#1948) and the raw corpus is passed as scan_corpus so newly excluded files are dropped instead of masquerading as deletions (#1908).

nodes.label: Interpreter Guard for Subcommands
nodes.rationale: Re-resolves the Python interpreter when .graphify_python is missing (e.g. the user deleted graphify-out/), and rejects shebang paths containing unexpected characters by falling back to python3.

nodes.label: /graphify query
nodes.rationale: Answers from the existing graph rather than rebuilding; the question is expanded against the graph's own vocabulary first so a wording mismatch does not collapse the answer to noise.

nodes.label: Honesty Rules
nodes.rationale: Never invent an edge (use AMBIGUOUS when unsure), never skip the corpus check warning, always show token cost, never hide cohesion scores behind symbols, and never render HTML for a graph over 5,000 nodes without warning.

nodes.label: Guide-After-Pipeline Exploration
nodes.rationale: The graph is the map and the agent is the guide: only three report sections are pasted and a single boundary-crossing question is offered, so the session feels like navigation rather than a one-shot report.

nodes.label: /graphify Pipeline (Codex Skill)
nodes.rationale: Same knowledge-graph pipeline adapted for the Codex host, whose multi-agent primitives differ from the Claude Agent tool.

nodes.label: Fast Path - Existing Graph
nodes.rationale: When graph.json already exists and the request is a natural-language question, Steps 1-5 are skipped entirely — no detect, no corpus check, no narrowing prompt — because the graph is already built.

nodes.label: Step 0 - GitHub Clone and Multi-Path Merge
nodes.rationale: Runs only for GitHub URLs or several local subfolders to merge; a plain local path skips it.

nodes.label: Step 1 - Ensure graphify Installed
nodes.rationale: Resolves the interpreter across uv tool, pipx, venv and system installs and persists it to .graphify_python so every later step uses the same Python; the scan root is saved so a later bare `graphify update` knows where to look.

nodes.label: Step 2 - Detect Files
nodes.rationale: Writes the sidecar from Python rather than a shell redirect so the block renders identically on PowerShell hosts without console-encoding drift (#2528); skipped_sensitive files are listed so a wrongly-flagged source is visible (#2106).

nodes.label: Corpus Size Gate and Subdirectory Narrowing
nodes.rationale: Above 2,000,000 words or 500 files the user is asked to narrow to a subfolder; converted sidecars under graphify-out/ are filtered out of the ranking, and a flat root-only corpus suggests --no-cluster instead since no subfolders exist to narrow to.

nodes.label: No-API-Key Policy
nodes.rationale: Code is extracted structurally with no LLM, and semantic extraction falls back to the host agent itself, so prompting for or blocking on ANTHROPIC_API_KEY/OPENAI_API_KEY is explicitly a misread of the skill; only GEMINI_API_KEY/GOOGLE_API_KEY are optionally read.

nodes.label: Part A - AST Structural Extraction
nodes.rationale: Deterministic and free, so it is started in parallel with the semantic subagents; this saves 5-15s on large corpora.

nodes.label: Part B - Semantic Extraction
nodes.rationale: A code-only corpus writes an empty semantic file and skips Part B, because Part C reads .graphify_semantic.json unconditionally and would otherwise hit FileNotFoundError.

nodes.label: Step B1 - Split Into Chunks
nodes.rationale: Chunks of 20-25 files group same-directory files together so cross-file relationships are more likely to be extracted; each image gets its own chunk because vision needs separate context.

nodes.label: Step B2 - spawn_agent Dispatch (Codex)
nodes.rationale: Codex uses spawn_agent/wait_agent/close_agent instead of the Agent tool and requires multi_agent = true in ~/.codex/config.toml; results are collected in memory, so invalid JSON is the failure signal rather than a missing file on disk.

nodes.label: Gemini Semantic Extraction Backend
nodes.rationale: Used only when GEMINI_API_KEY/GOOGLE_API_KEY is already set; defaults to gemini-3-flash-preview, overridable via GRAPHIFY_GEMINI_MODEL or --model.

nodes.label: references/extraction-spec.md
nodes.rationale: Holds the verbatim subagent prompt (JSON schema, node-ID rules, confidence rubric, hyperedge and vision rules); loaded lazily only when a chunk holds a doc, paper, or image.

nodes.label: /graphify Pipeline (Devin Skill)
nodes.rationale: Same pipeline for the Devin host, declaring allowed-tools (read/grep/glob/exec) and a sonnet model in frontmatter.

nodes.label: Karpathy /raw Folder Workflow
nodes.rationale: Drop anything into a folder — papers, tweets, screenshots, code, notes — and get a structured graph showing what you did not know was connected.

nodes.label: Persistent Graph, Audit Trail, Cross-Document Surprise
nodes.rationale: The three things an AI assistant alone cannot do: relationships survive across sessions in graph.json, every edge is tagged EXTRACTED/INFERRED/AMBIGUOUS so found is distinguishable from invented, and community detection surfaces connections nobody would think to ask about.

nodes.label: Step 2.5 - Transcribe Video/Audio
nodes.rationale: Video and audio cannot be read directly, so they are transcribed to text and treated as docs; the host model writes the Whisper domain hint itself from god-node labels so no separate API call is needed, falling back to a generic prompt when the corpus is video-only.

nodes.label: GRAPHIFY_WHISPER_PROMPT Domain Hint
nodes.rationale: Seeding Whisper with a one-sentence domain hint derived from god-node labels improves transcription accuracy on domain vocabulary.

nodes.label: EXTRACTED / INFERRED / AMBIGUOUS Rubric
nodes.rationale: Tagging every edge with its provenance is what makes the graph auditable — the reader can tell what was found from what was invented.
